key.name: auto-location
key.description: Use IP-based location detection instead of a manual place

key.name: show-icon
key.summary: Show the animated icon in the panel

key.name: animate
key.description: When off, the icon renders a single static frame

key.name: provider
key.description: All providers are keyless and free. open-meteo = Open-Meteo global forecast (default; model selectable via om-model); met-norway = Norwegian Meteorological Institute locationforecast, CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution (reports precipitation amounts, not probabilities, so the precipitation chart is model-derived); noaa-nws = US National Weather Service (US locations only, official forecasts, station observations for current conditions)

key.name: om-model
key.description: Which forecast model Open-Meteo routes to. best_match = Open-Meteo's regional pick (often the US GFS, which frequently over-forecasts coastal heat); ecmwf_ifs025 = ECMWF IFS, generally the most accurate global model and what most premium apps lean on (default); icon_seamless = German DWD ICON (~7-day range); gfs_seamless = US NOAA GFS. Ignored by other providers. Out to a week the models genuinely disagree — if the weekend forecast looks off, try another model before doubting the provider

key.name: condition-strip
key.summary: Hourly condition strip on the chart

key.name: condition-pos
key.description: top = along the chart top; bottom = directly above the hour labels, Apple-weather style (default)

key.name: text-emboss
key.description: Soft shadow (dark theme) or halo (light theme) under card text and the ghost buttons. Off by default: adaptive contrast-aware ink makes the shadows unnecessary.

key.name: menu-style
key.description: animated = translucent weather sky, solid = the sky dimmed under a wash, accent = no sky: the shell theme's own popup background with the charts drawn in the OS accent colour

key.name: preview-scene
key.summary: Temporarily preview an animation on the panel icon
key.description: Set by the preferences window; the extension clears it back to empty when the preview ends

key.name: live-scene
key.summary: The sky the menu is currently painting
key.description: Runtime state written by the extension; the preferences legend shows it as the idle backdrop preview

key.name: live-night
key.summary: Whether that sky is the night variant
key.description: Runtime state written by the extension

key.name: windy-threshold
key.summary: Wind speed (km/h) that triggers the wind animation
